## Bug Description
A clear and concise description of the defect encountered.

## Reproduction Steps
1. Navigate to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

## Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what should have happened.

## Actual Behavior & Logs
Include terminal output, browser console errors, or HTTP response envelopes.

## Environment Details
- Environment: [Local / Staging / Production]
- Node.js Version: [e.g. 22.x LTS]
- Browser / Client: [e.g. Chrome 132, Safari 18, Android Voice AI APK]
- Operating System: [e.g. macOS, Linux, Windows, Android 16]

## Regression Test
Link to newly added regression test in `tests/` that isolates this failure mode.
